rule: One leading task-increment right singular vector per V, Attention-output, MLP-up and MLP-down matrix in fixed target-selected layers. For V and up, remove the exact LayerNorm affine-null direction and renormalize. Freeze all vectors and input means before loading partners. Oracle resets the rank-one task update and compensates its mean in the bias. Public-support resets all edited matrices and biases (V rows only, preserving Q/K). No rank or amplitude search.
scope: Necessary-condition diagnostic, not a new defense, protected-model attack or NUFILT reproduction. Exact directions and means are oracle knowledge. No extra training, gradient updates or response reconstruction.
data_usage: 128 fresh unlabeled MNIST training calibration and 128 fresh disjoint confirmation images for geometry. Recovery cost reuses the previously inspected 2048-image MNIST training confirmation. No official test images or labels used.
decision: Continue to a single joint functional-cancellation candidate only if both union oracle erasure and public-support replacement lose at least 5 pp in the fixed eight-expert fusion. This is a declared research-priority threshold, not an impossibility theorem. Report every standalone and fusion cost regardless of the gate. Do not retune this direction family on failure.
